I've designed a factorial-style probe. Each of the 5 hyperparameters gets 20 "up" edits. Every edit runs from a mid-band base configuration (alpha=0.000278, batch=40, depth=2, lr=0.00167, width=101). The other hyperparameters are then shifted into their low or high bands, one at a time and in a few pairs. This lets interactions show up as differences in the edit's effect across bands.
